title: JOVRA Room snapshot envelope (jovra.room.snapshot/1)
description: Latest-state replacement published by the elected host. Receivers reject the wrong session, an older host epoch, another host key or host device under the same epoch, any non-increasing snapshotSeq and any decreasing eventRevision; a newer epoch is refused without any state change until an authenticated host transfer is reconciled. Device entries must be on the roster, which changes only with a higher rosterRevision. No field asserts freshness: each receiver derives it from ageAtHostMs plus its own monotonic time.

devices.description: One to six consenting camera phones.
